title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Hierarchy of Controls
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: According to the Hierarchy of Controls, which of the following measures is considered the **least** effective method for controlling a hazard?
questions.explain: The Hierarchy of Controls lists PPE as the last line of defense and the least effective control measure because it relies on human behavior and does not remove the hazard itself. The order from most to least effective is: Elimination, Substitution, Engineering Controls, Administrative Controls, PPE.
